description: This Java source file defines the LiveSignalEnforcement class, which manages enforcement of live signals such as commands, events, and messaging within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for enforcing permissions, publishing signals, and handling different signal types with integration to pub/sub mechanisms and caches.

classes.name: LiveSignalEnforcement
classes.description: This class enforces permissions and policies for live signals (commands, events, messages) in the Eclipse Ditto platform, including publishing signals via pub/sub and validating access rights.

classes.name: LiveSignalEnforcement.Provider
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of LiveSignalEnforcement that are applicable to specific signals, with caching and external pub/sub dependency injection.

methods.name: enforce
methods.description: Performs enforcement of the current signal, including permission checks and publishing.

methods.name: doEnforce
methods.description: Internal enforcement logic based on signal type and enforcer data.

methods.name: enforceLiveCommandResponse
methods.description: Handles enforcement logic for live command responses, routing to appropriate response receivers.

methods.name: enforceLiveSignal
methods.description: Enforces live signals based on streaming type, including commands, events, and other signals.

methods.name: enforceLiveEvent
methods.description: Enforces permissions for live event signals.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Checks if a given signal is a live signal based on its streaming type.

methods.name: enforceMessageCommand
methods.description: Enforces permission for message commands before publishing.

methods.name: publishMessageCommand
methods.description: Publishes a message command with appropriate access controls applied.

methods.name: rejectMessageCommand
methods.description: Creates an exception for unauthorized message commands.

methods.name: publishLiveSignal
methods.description: Publishes a signal via pub/sub mechanism, adding response receivers if needed.

methods.name: addToResponseReceiver
methods.description: Registers a response receiver for the signal if response is required.

methods.name: setUniqueCorrelationIdForGlobalDispatching
methods.description: Ensures a unique correlation ID for signals to support global dispatching.

methods.name: findUniqueCorrelationId
methods.description: Recursively finds a unique correlation ID not already in use in the cache.
